book.name: Rebelesen
book.title: REBELESEN Ameh Kindrei leheya i ta Jon

content: Udu hamon ta lakou mara-ei nane doh ano, jo anyolom angelo ari ja atah udu kandrah eme andri. Iy badeh, boto-on labai, ma lomada nyosowan badeh, lomotani kon munyak mara-ei anya.
Ma iy asehek sahou boto-on labai i buku doh,

content.text: “Kon tinan Babilon mene udu bwele-en labai,
arile nadah iy ndratohou ndra andri mara-ei!
Nadah badeh, iy ndrala ndrahune iri malawin ndra-in ta balik are aliy.
Iri malawin ndra-in ma hawe iri sirih ta aimon lakou bolo-an,
ma hawe iri sirih ndra-in mara-ei, are loboho doh ale.
Tasah, lau mwan ma badih badu kon munyak tinan mara-ei mene atudun iri kindrei,
iri amekes na sukumada kei badeh, ndramekes kandriyen ta karei solo-an labai hawen.
Idoh i buku iri ale badeh, ndranyuwi waen tan boto-on labai ta lolo-ou.
Ma iri kabin badu kon munyak mara-ei amekes karei hawen ale.
Ma hawe iri lau nadu batun ta amekes ba-en ma ta sisih badu kon munyak mara-ei badeh, akohok luk tinan labai ta iri kandriyen tan solo-an ndra-in, ma bwilin winiyan bama ta aliy bwe.”

content: Ano ja, jo anuhun boho ndramak ari asehek sahou udu bolo kandrah i buku doh,

content.text: “Aha lau tek, aha kame len ta iy badih badeh!
Idah kameh aha winiyan bala bolo maha-a kandriyen ndra-in tan bwe;
eme ma aha ale winiyan bakohok bundruwe iri ndra-in tan bwe!
Suhuye iri kandriyen ndra-in tan mara-ei badeh, ili isos kandrah,
eme ma Kindrei bwetenei iri kandriyen ndra-in mara-ei ta kon doh.
Aha badeh, kabwetenei iri kandriyen mara-ei iy badih ta karei amekes ili tiri rayah nane op, ano aha baramekes barala tan ai.
Iy badeh, amekes kandriyen rayah ja ili le bwele-e bwena, ma bwidiy ili solo-an labai.
Eme ma aha kamekes kili tan ma sola, ki-in hamon le tiri kandriyen mara-ei, iy nane amekes.
Iy badeh, ale tubuni gwa lolo-ou i bolo bwesam.
Ya, aha ale katubuni gwa lolo-ou kili ndra-in labai ja ma solo-an kili tan.
Iy ale badeh, atudun nyaran amwenen, ma amekes kandriyen solo-an ndra-in ta karei, ma hawe iri kandriyen ndra-in rayah ja.
Eme ma aha kadeu sisi-in ma solo-an kili badan, kili, kili winiya le iri kandriyen ndra-in iy nane amekes.

Iy badeh, asehek iy i buku doh, ‘Jo badeh, ere mwilis, jo manyah udu bada koyeu ta mwilis. Jo bala buku badih udun imek ma iy ere laleyah bwe. Iri maha-an kameh winiyan basahan tek bwe, ma jo kameh winiyan baden ja bwai.’
Ta budon doh le, bolo len ari le kameh, iri lakou marakon ndra-in doh kameh asahan tan.
Sik solo-an kameh asahan, ma lau solo-an kameh aden, son kameh asahan i tinan mara-ei.
Ma jih kameh sulumwi Babilon andrakak mara-ei iu.
Laban Kindrei boto-on labai, ma iy kameh edeu bundruwe iri kandriyen ndra-in tan.

content: “Iri kabin mara-ei badu kon munyak badeh, mene atudun kindrei ta wasai iri amekes na sukumada kei, ma amekes kandriyen solo-an ndra-in ta karei hawen. Eme ma iri kabin mara-ei doh kameh anyolom kasu-er ta jih nane asun iy, iri kameh alim ade iri, aden, ma tikisiy le ai.
Iri kameh anoh labai, tasah sisi-in ndra-in nane bokoro-ei Babilon doh kameh asahan tiri. Eme ma iri badeh, ales are ndra len labai, ma aden ma asehek i buku doh,

content.text: “‘Lakou ta tikisiy, Babilon, iri lau katikisiy ou labai,
tasah sisi-in tinan labai kameh ewek bwele-em!
Ou kon laba tinan labai, ma ou kon boto-on labai!
Udu bolo awa ari le, bundruwe kandriyen ndra-in tam badeh, ndrasos hawem!’

content: “Iri nadu batun solo-an ta amekes ba-en ma ta sisih badu kon munyak mara-ei kameh, abudon ta kon le doh, ma iri kameh aden ndranyen ma tikisi iy. Tasah, lau kameh winiyan basih lokowa iri ja bwai.

Iri sanuw buku bek nyikilikin, silba, bek man nyikilikin hawe iri bek rayah sowa iri badeh, tinan labai, ma iri kolau belen mwasin labai, iri kolau saraman tariyen solo-an hawe iri kolau sosowan. Ma iri kei tiri solo-an manahun buburen mwasin labai, ma iri lakou rayah ja iri amekes na kasoh tiri elepen, ma lakou rayah ja, sowan laba tinan labai iri mwan ma badih amekes na kei. Iri bras ma hayen, iri bek tariyen mwasin labai; idoh iri lau kameh winiyan basih ja bwai.

Ma sanuw rayah ja i buku sinamon, lei ta aimon, eh ma ndrelekei ta amekes suluw manahu buburen mwasin ma ta anyas i bada lau. Waen hawe ndrelekei, ndrom plaua ma wit, bulumakau ma sipsip, iri hos ma hawe karis tiri, iri lau bonyo-ou hawe lau awas rayah ja. Iri lakou tiri mara-ei doh badeh, iri lau kameh winiyan basih ja bwai.

Ya, iri nadu batun nane amekes lakou ta sisih, kameh asehek i tan i buku doh, ‘Iri lakou mara-ei nane sowa iri tinan labai, ou ndrasakalamiy hawe nyasou tam mwasin, iri lakou marakon doh badeh, ndramani madan. Iri mwan ma badih kameh winiyan banyolom iri lakou doh bado badam ja bwai.’

“Ya, iri lau nadu batun ta amekes ba-en ma ta sisih nane amekes iri lakou doh, ma akohok luk solo-an badu kon tinan doh, iri badeh, anoh labai, tasah sisi-in hawe ndra-in ta kon laba tinan doh kameh akohok iri. Eme ma iri badeh, bales bare mirihik tan bwai. Iri kameh aden ma tikisi iy.
Iri kameh aden i buku doh,

content.text: “‘Ahi tikisiy, ahi tikisiy tinan labai, ta kon tinan doh!
Tasah sisi-in tinan labai ndrame ndrala la-un.
Iy mene anyasou na awin belen hawe kolau saraman tariyen solo-an labai udu aliy,
ma iy nyosowani badan mara-ei na bek nyikilikin, bek rayah hawe man sowa iri tinan labai.
Ma sese luwen bwe, buku bolo awa ari le badeh, iri luk ma nyasou mari ndrandrakak ndrano ndra-au.’

content: “Ma hawe iri lau tinan ta atondrok iri ndron mara-ei udu bolo ndras, ma iri lau ta sandroh ala ndron are kon rakon ala rakon, ma hawe iri lau nadu batun badu bolo ndras, iri mara-ei doh kameh ales are len labai ta kon tinan Babilon.
Ya, iri anyolom kasu-er ta jih nane asun iy, iri kameh anyar i buku doh, ‘Ari kon tinan udu kede-eh ja, i buku kon tinan Babilon doh, o bwai?’
Iri kameh atah koloweh ili batu iri, iri aden, ma iri tikisiy tinan labai. Eme ma iri asehek i buku doh,

content.text: “‘Ahi tikisiy, ahi tikisiy tinan labai, ta kon tinan doh!
Tasah sisi-in tinan labai ndrame ndrala la-un.
Tama iri ndron mara-ei ale atas bolo ndras asahan iri nadu batun ta luk, badeh, na le kon tinan nane doh.
Ahi tikisiy tinan labai!
Tasah, udu bolo awa ari le badeh, iy ndratohou mara-ei ndrano ndra-au!
Aha lau marakon badu kandrah, hawe iri mwan ma badih ta Kindrei, ma iri aposel hawe iri propet, aha marakon badeh, kasekesek ta lakou nane asahan ta kon tinan doh.
Tasah, Kindrei badeh, ndralebelei bundruwe iri lakou tan ndrala.
Ma ta kandriyen tan doh, iy edeu bundruwe kandriyen ndra-in mene kon tinan nane doh amekes ewek taha.’”

content: Sahou mara-ei ano le badeh, jo anyolom angelo ari boto-on labai, iy andrei bek ari laba tinan, i buku bek laba tinan ta atisih wit. Iy tutuni bek nane doh i loken, ma iy akahei iu ili andri atuh i bolo ndras. Ma iy anya,

content.text: “Ta kandriyen doh le badeh, iri kameh andrei kon tinan Babilon, ma akahei boto-on labai ili andri,
eme ma iri lau kameh winiyan banyolom iy ja bwai.
Eme ma nyaro iri ndran iri aloh hap, ma nyaro iri ndran bala-eu, ma hawe iri ndran rayah ja hawe ndrah,
iri lau kameh winiyan banuhun oro bado hawem ja bwai.
Iri lau ale tana iri ta amekes lakou na kei, o hayen, o bek nyikilikin, o lakou mwasin ja,
iri lau ta tanan doh winiyan bare hawem ja bwai.
Ma nyaro bek laba tinan ta atisih wit,
iri lau kameh winiyan banuhun iy bado hawem ja bwai.
Lomada sun kameh winiyan banya lomadam ja bwai.
Sohowa loweu ma bihin anya katasou,
iri kameh winiyan banuhun bado bolo kon tinan Babilon ja bwai.
Bwena mene iri nadu batun tam ta amekes ba-en ma ta sisih badeh, lahou tiri udu aliy, ma nyara iri badeh, tinan labai ere bolo kon munyak.
Ma ou badeh, wendreyani iri mwan ma badih na kandriyen tam ta balahak ma ta lakou solo-an ndra-in, ou a-en hamon ta aliy,
ma idoh mene ariu ndrine iri ta a-en hamon tiri kandriyen ndra-in ou amekes.
Ma Kindrei anyolom kon tinan Babilon doh badeh, maha-an ndra-in labai ta adai iri propet, hawe iri mwan ma badih tan badeh, udu aliy.
Ma iri mwan ma badih mara-ei badu kon munyak, ala iri lau ndra-in mene, ndradai iri ndramak badeh,
bundruwe iri lakou marakon doh ale udu kon tinan Babilon le.”
